sloka: उपस्थितं पयुञ्जानस्त्वयि सान्त्वमनर्थकम् ।अर्थेनैवाद्य ते भर्ता कौसल्यां योजयिष्यति ॥२-७-२५॥
transliteration: upasthitaṁ payuñjānastvayi sāntvamanarthakam ।arthenaivādya te bhartā kausalyāṁ yojayiṣyati ॥2-7-25॥

translations.english: When your husband approaches you he swears in meaningless, appeasing words. But today he is going to bestow benefit on Kausalya only.
